title: Adding min()/max()/sum()/avg() aggregates wrapped the caller-supplied column name in sqlalchemy.text() with no check that it is a real model field, so a crafted column string injects SQL into the aggregate query.

findings.explanation: The change only adds a helper function that validates disallowed field arguments and passes them to the ORM field constructor. No raw SQL strings are built from user‑controlled data; the ORM continues to use parameterised queries internally.
